value.actual_behavior:
#59 reads status "fixed" in the public tracker with validated_at, triaged_at,
status_notes, ticket_url and fix_pr_url all null. All three paths it reports
are still published and still answer 404. Nothing about them changed between
filing and closure.
value.description:
This is report #53 caught in the act, on a report whose subject we can verify
precisely. #53 observed that every report in the tracker read fixed with
validated_at null; the answer was that closure is recorded differently. #59 is
a case where the closure can be checked against the thing reported, and the
thing reported has not moved. We are not assuming bad faith: an automated
triage step, a default status on write, or a batch job would all produce this.
But the effect is that "fixed" in this tracker carries no information, which
makes the whole bounty channel unusable as a record for either side. We cannot
tell your real fixes from your defaults, and neither can you. Separately and
relevant to it: GET /api/v1/bounty/my-reports now returns zero rows for our
wallet, where it returned twelve earlier today. That is the only view a hunter
has of their own submissions, so while it is empty we cannot check any closure
you make. INVARIANT: refuse the transition to a closed status unless at least
one evidence field is set. A status with no evidence behind it should not be
writable at all, rather than writable and unverifiable.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-tracker-closure-rate] All 15 reports in the public bounty tracker read 'fixed', and validated_at is null on every one
    left: [59]
    right: 20
    sources: {'endpoint': 'GET /api/v1/bounty/reports'}
    population: {'rows_returned': 20, 'closed': 20, 'server_total': 28}
    reason: 1 of 20 closed reports carry no evidence field at all (validated_at, triaged_at, severity_confirmed, ticket_url, fix_pr_url, status_notes)

REPRODUCE:
  - GET /api/v1/bounty/reports -> report 59, status fixed, every evidence field null
  - GET /api/v1/account -> 404, and the path is still present in llms.txt
  - GET /api/v1/agentbook/post -> 404, and the path is still present in llms.txt
  - GET /api/v1/clob/order -> 404, and the path is still present in agent-skills.json

AUTOMATED CHECKS (public repo: github.com/zakutana/qa-cymetica):
  tests/rest/test_bounty_tracker.py::test_closures_in_the_public_tracker_carry_evidence

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: read-only
verification of the REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces. No
state-changing account action, no trading, no order placement, no deposit or
withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects are out of scope.
Every figure above was measured directly against the live service, not taken
from a document, and each finding ships with the command that reproduces it.
